definitions.explanation: A place where horse races are held and bets are placed on them.

examples.japanese: {競馬場|けいばじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{競馬場|けいばじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧いっぱいだ。
examples.english: The racetrack is packed on weekends.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧{競馬場|けいばじょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{初夏|しょか}→初夏：11740_shoka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{日本|にっぽん}→日本：00320_nippon⟧ダービー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The Japanese Derby is run at Tokyo Racecourse every year in early summer.

notes:
⟦{競馬|けいば}→競馬：00207_keiba⟧ (horse racing) + {場|じょう} (a place for an activity).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{競馬|けいば}→競馬：00207_keiba⟧: horse racing
- ⟦{馬券|ばけん}→馬券：22321_baken⟧: a betting ticket for a horse race
- {競輪場|けいりんじょう}: a bicycle-racing track
- {競艇場|きょうていじょう}: a boat-racing venue

In Japan, betting is legal only on these publicly run races, so each venue is also a betting place.
